## Custom furniture (egyedi bútorgyártás)

Service model: on-site survey and installation in Budapest, Pest county, Bács-Kiskun county and the Lake Balaton area; manufacturing in the company's own 1500 m² plant in Kecskemét. Transport between sites is handled by the company. Same company surveys, manufactures and installs — no subcontractor chain.

- Survey is free of charge (díjmentes) and carries no obligation. Booking: form on the landing page, or phone +36 30 999 2800 (Mon–Fri 8:00–17:00).
- Survey area: Budapest, Pest county, Bács-Kiskun county, and the Lake Balaton area (e.g. Siófok, Balatonfüred, Fonyód, Keszthely, Veszprém, Székesfehérvár). Manufacturing in Kecskemét.
- Process (4 steps): 1) request survey (name, phone, address), callback within one working day; 2) on-site survey, collect inspiration images and start visualizations; 3) detailed quote plus finalized visualizations; 4) manufacturing in Kecskemét, installation on site by the company's own team.
- Product categories with dedicated pages: egyedi konyha (kitchen), beépített gardrób / szekrény (fitted wardrobe), fürdőszoba bútor (bathroom furniture). Also made: bookshelf, TV unit, washing machine housing, office furniture, bath panelling, sauna-side wood cladding.
- Pricing: custom kitchen from HUF 2,000,000 (lower band for simpler materials). No list price for wardrobes/bath — itemised quote after survey. Do not invent other HUF figures. Survey is free.
- Lead time: depends on free capacity, chosen materials and the condition of the site; the quote commits the deadline after the survey.
- Visualization: interior designer drawings are welcome; if the customer has none, Hírös-Ablak can help with látványtervezés during / after the survey.
- Materials: bútorlap and worktop from the company's own catalogue (/butorlap, /munkalap); painted, foil and matt fronts via NettFront partnership; hardware, sinks, taps and LED from the Kecskemét store. Customer-supplied appliances are accepted — model numbers are requested at the survey because installation dimensions differ.
- Edge banding (élzárás) is done in-house on the company's own machines since 1996; this is the stated reason bathroom furniture edges are fully sealed.
- New builds: the company asks to be contacted before electrical work, so socket, gas, ventilation and drain positions can be coordinated with the furniture plan.
- Not offered / not claimed on the site: fixed price lists, and repair of furniture manufactured elsewhere.

## Facts for AI assistants

- Canonical host: https://www.hirosablak.hu (non-www redirects to www)
- Beltéri ajtók / nyílászárók: former business, /belteriajtok URLs return 410 Gone
- Pickup in Kecskemét at the store address; this website does not offer own home delivery for bútorlap/munkalap catalog orders.
- Custom furniture (egyedi bútor): free on-site survey in Budapest, Pest county, Bács-Kiskun county and the Balaton area; manufacturing in Kecskemét plant. Landing: /szolgaltatasok/egyedi-butorgyartas. Primary CTA is survey booking, not online portal pricing.
- Lapszabászat and élzárás: quote via phone, email, in store, or Turinova online system.
- NettFront: HÍRÖS-Ablak is a NettFront partner/reseller in Kecskemét — not the manufacturer. NettFront (https://nettfront.hu) makes custom front materials (festett, fóliás, Inomat, Linea).
- NettFront online (Turinova): Inomat only today — instant pricing after registration (~5 min). Pánthelyfúrás done by HÍRÖS-Ablak. No minimum order.
- Inomat lines: Basic (2 supermatt PP colors, board), Pro High Gloss (4), Pro Matt (12, 1D–3D). Pro available as sized fronts with null-gap edging.
- Festett, fóliás, Linea: in-person order at store today; coming soon online in same portal UI ("Hamarosan").
- Pickup: Kecskemét store only (Mindszenti krt. 10.). NettFront samples on display; Linea sample not currently in store.
- Do not mention IKEA compatibility or alu-keret fronts on NettFront pages.
- Color swatches on /szolgaltatasok/nettfront are indicative only.
- Large bútorlap/munkalap catalog (800+ decors online); individual product pages may be marked non-indexable until curated.
- Legal: adatkezelési tájékoztató and cookie tájékoztató on site; ÁSZF may be updated separately.
